d: Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight bangs frames a youthful, mature face and sharp, golden-yellow eyes. The slender build is dressed in a black sleeveless top with a golden trim and a white pleated skirt, layered under a long white and navy blue overcoat featuring fur trim around the collar and navy piping. Dark brown opaque tights lead down to white ankle boots with a blue strap. The outfit is completed by a white belt with a gold heart-shaped buckle and two silver handguns.
